senses.definition: (archaic) A wheelhorse (horse near wheel of carriage).

quotes.text: How proud felt Pierre: In fancy’s eye, he saw the horse-ghosts a-tandem in the van; “These are but wheelers”—cried young Pierre—“the leaders are the generations.”
quotes.reference: 1852, Herman Melville, Pierre; or The Ambiguities:

senses.definition: (in combination) A vehicle having the specified number or type of wheels.

quotes.text: "Excellent," said Sherlock Holmes. "Send the boy for a four-wheeler, and we shall be off at once."
quotes.reference: 1893, Arthur Conan Doyle, The Greek Interpreter:

senses.definition: (UK, historical, Liverpool) A sett in a stoneway.

quotes.text: These wheelers are now made from the same class of rock as the rest of the pavement, […]
